items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: which Ogis was a member at the time, Ogis' associate, with his bass.

ctx.x: Okay, yeah. I just want to get it down.

So, uh, I came over this Saturday evening and I...as he suggested that I do. And, uh, we got all the band together, which Ogis was a member at the time, Ogis' associate, with his bass. And after all the members of the band, we booted the car and we hated it for the kill. When we got out to Pearl River, not Pearl River, Jordan River, there were cars lined up, oh, two or three blocks on this side of the river and likewise on the other side. People have been tired of there for as much as 10 and 12 hours waiting for…

half a block or so out and the current from that water rushing down from higher land. You can see those trees doing this, you know, waiting. Later on we heard the motor sputter and all of a sudden the water pushed the car clean off that embankment down into that deep water. And when that cold water hit my feet, unbeknownst to myself, I beat everybody out the car. I said, no, the top of it tilted. And I heard him say, wait a minute, wait a minute. I went out there.
